en.hubeali:
Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Shuayb Al Aqarquqy, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The one who was a believer in Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and the Last Day, so let him fulfil when he promises’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Shu’ayb al-‘Aqarqufi from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “
The Messenger of Allah has said, ‘Whoever believes in Allah, and in the Day of Judgment, must fulfill his promise.’”
